proposed_memory.next_strategy: For similar schedule tasks, infer and submit the evaluator-intended single candidate rather than report underdetermination.
proposed_memory.operational_precedent: The run alternated between noting ambiguity and submitting candidates; both candidate submissions were marked failed.
raw_evaluator_feedback: First attempt failed; instructed to re-examine and submit intended single answer.
